notes: SBI PO cutoffs work differently from SSC or Railways cutoffs. The official result PDFs (prelims shortlist, mains shortlist, final selection) are **roll-number lists only** and do not print the category-wise cutoff figures. SBI discloses marks and cutoff-related scores **only through its candidate-wise marks utility** on the careers page, where a candidate enters a roll number and date of birth to see his or her own scores. What the official advertisement does publish is the **structure** of every cutoff stage: no sectional cutoff in the Prelims (aggregate-only shortlist of about 10 times the category-wise vacancies), sectional plus aggregate qualifying cutoffs in the Mains (about 3 times the vacancies shortlisted for Phase-III), minimum qualifying marks in Group Exercise and Interview decided by the Bank, and a final merit normalised to 100 (Mains 75 + GE & Interview 25). Exact official cutoff numbers for recent cycles are therefore **not reproducible from any public official PDF**; treat any exact figure circulating elsewhere as unverified and confirm through the official marks utility links below.

prelims.source: https://sbi.bank.in/webfiles/uploads/files_2627/08/SBIPO2026-Prelims-WTRESULT-15_columns.pdf (official prelims result, roll numbers only) and https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/popre-results-2026 (official marks utility)
prelims.note: Result declared August 2026. No sectional cutoff; shortlist is roughly 10 times the category-wise vacancies. Category-wise cutoff figures are not printed in the official PDF; check the marks utility.

prelims.source: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/po-pre-result-2025 (official prelims marks utility; exam held 4-5 August 2025)
prelims.note: Exact category-wise cutoffs were not published in any official PDF for this cycle; they are visible only per candidate through the official marks utility. Figures quoted by coaching sites are unverified reproductions.

prelims.source: https://sbi.co.in/web/careers (official 2024-25 PO section; prelims held in March 2025)
prelims.note: Exact category-wise cutoffs not available in an official public PDF; check the official marks pages. Widely-quoted numbers (for example, UR around the low 60s out of 100) come from coaching-site reproductions and could not be verified against an official document.

mains.note: Mains held 12 September 2026 (tentative date per prelims result notice); result awaited at the time of the last check (6 October 2026). Sectional cutoffs apply for each of the four objective tests and the descriptive paper, plus a minimum aggregate qualifying score, all decided by the Bank. Grand total is 230 marks (200 objective + 30 descriptive) under the 2026-27 scheme.

mains.source: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/po-mains-2025 (official Mains & Interview marks utility) and official Mains result PDF on the careers page
mains.note: In this cycle the descriptive paper carried 50 marks, so the Mains grand total was 250 (200 objective + 50 descriptive). Cutoff figures are not printed in the official result PDF; only the shortlist roll numbers and the per-candidate marks utility are official.
Descriptive paper carried 50 marks (grand total 250). Sectional and aggregate cutoffs were decided by the Bank; exact figures are not in the official public PDFs.

final.note: Result awaited at the time of the last check (6 October 2026). Final merit: Mains (230) converted to 75 marks + Group Exercise & Interview (50) converted to 25 marks. Psychometric Test is profiling only, with no marks.

final.source: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/po-allotment-letter-2026 (official letter-to-successful-candidates utility) and the official final result PDF on the careers page
final.note: Final result (roll numbers) was declared on 19 December 2025. The official PDF does not print category-wise final cutoffs; converted scores out of 100 (Mains 75 + GE & Interview 25) are visible per candidate through the official marks utility.

final.source: https://sbi.co.in/web/careers/po-allotment-letter-2025 (official letter-to-successful-candidates utility) and the official final result PDF on the careers page
final.note: Final merit used the same 75:25 weighting (Mains 250 converted to 75, GE & Interview 50 converted to 25). Exact category-wise final cutoffs are not published in the official public PDF; unverified coaching-site figures (for example, UR around 46 out of 100) circulate but could not be confirmed from an official document.
